scope: Standard-library local ZIP fixtures; no GitHub mutation or live release download. Real release archive verification is tracked by the publication workflow.

checks.check: local download and archive SHA-256 verification
extracted file size and SHA-256 verification
parent traversal, absolute paths, drive paths and backslash rejection
path-traversal ZIP rejected without writing outside destination
archive SHA-256 mismatch rejected without finalizing download
member SHA-256 mismatch rejected and partial member removed
corrupt ZIP payload CRC rejected without finalizing member
dataset all CLI flow downloads, extracts, verifies and removes cached ZIP
check-only fails for missing data without changing filesystem
